description: Validate a ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3b or XRechnung 3.0 XML against official EN 16931 XSD, KoSIT German Business Rules (BR-DE-*), and veraPDF ISO 19005-3. Use to check statutory compliance and diagnose rule violations; use parse_erechnung instead when you want to extract invoice fields and line items. Returns JSON with valid (boolean), profile, format, pdfaCompliant, errors[], and warnings[] (each with rule_id, field, message, and human_hint).

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3b or XRechnung XML file to validate (provide either fileBase64 or xmlContent).

filename.description: Optional original filename ending in .pdf or .xml to assist content-type detection.

xmlContent.description: Raw UTF-8 XRechnung or Factur-X XML string to validate (alternative to fileBase64).

name: validate_erechnung
